home.description: Choose a node, download its configuration, or scan its QR code in the matching VPN app.
home.invalidDescription: This link is invalid, expired, or has been revoked.
home.invalidHelp: Ask your administrator for a new subscription link.
home.unavailableDescription: Your subscription could not be loaded safely. Try again shortly.
home.placementUnavailable: This node is visible, but its configuration cannot be retrieved right now.
home.emptyDescription: Your administrator has not assigned any VPN nodes to this client yet.
home.qrDescription: Scan this code with the matching VPN application. Do not share it.
home.privacyNotice: Configurations and QR codes are retrieved live and are not stored by this portal.
